derivation: Every field below was read out of the driver's own 68000 instructions in the local ROM. No external write-up was used and no ROM byte was executed.

banner_z80.text: Ancient Music Driver -MD- Z80 Program Version 1.06

z80_image.evidence: lea.l $62e38-ish source + lea.l $a00000,a2 + move.w #$1fff,d0 + move.b (a1)+,(a2)+ + dbra, then move.w #$0,$a11200 / move.w #$0,$a11100

song_index.value_semantics: offset of the song header, relative to table_rom_offset; 0 = slot not used
song_index.slot_count_evidence: andi.w #$ff,d0 then lsl.w #$2,d0 then move.l (a0,d0.w),d1 then adda.l d1,a0

track_header.value_semantics: offset of the track's sequence stream, relative to the song header address itself; 0 = empty track slot
track_header.evidence: movea.l <header>,a0 / move.l a0,d1 / move.b $1(a0),d3 / lsl.w #$8,d3 / move.b (a0),d3 / addq.l #$2,a0 / add.l d1,d3 / move.l d3,$c(a6)

stream_event_model.fetch_evidence: movea.l $2(a6),a0 / moveq #$0,d2 / move.b (a0)+,d2 / cmpi.b #$f0,d2 / bcc <command dispatch> / tst.b d2 / bne <note path> / <end-of-stream handler>

events.evidence: tst.b d2 / beq -> bsr $62156 (end handler), stream cursor not advanced past the marker

events.value_semantics: length = byte - 0x80, stored to track fields $06/$07 (a 1-byte countdown at $06 is later decremented by subq.b #$1,$6(a6))
events.evidence: bclr.b #$7,d2 / bne <duration path> -> move.b d2,$6(a6) / move.b d2,$7(a6)

events.value_semantics: operand low nibble indexes a 16-entry big-endian word table; operand high nibble is shifted left by 7 and added. The table is read as data only - the mapping to a concert pitch or MIDI number is NOT proven and is reported as an opaque code.
events.evidence: move.b (a0)+,d0 / andi.b #$f,d0 / add.w d0,d0 / lea $62da8(pc),a2 / move.w (a2,d0.w),d1 / andi.w #$f0,d3 / lsl.w #$7,d3

command_jump_table.encoding: big-endian uint16, relative to the table address

widths.note: handler re-dispatches through a second table at $6229a indexed by the operand; the sub-cases may consume more bytes
handler skips 2 bytes (addq.l #$2,a0) without interpreting them
handler works on track state only
added to track field $12 (a delta, not an absolute)
handler stores into $84(a6) and repeats through the same lea; the repeat count is not proven
handler skips 2 bytes without interpreting them
handler re-dispatches through a second jump table at $61fb8, i.e. a nested command space

envelope_table.note: indexed by (track $12 + track $6f) >> 1; table length not proven

limitations: Offsets are specific to Story of Thor (Europe). Other Ancient ROMs carry the same structures at different addresses and need their own anchors.
Only the stream *structure* is proven. Instrument, FM/PSG voice and sample representations were not reached by this profile.
The pitch word table is reported as an opaque code; no note-name or MIDI mapping is claimed.
Three commands (0xf4, 0xfc, 0xff) have unproven operand widths, so a stream walk stops there instead of guessing.
rom_sha256_note: sha-256 of the NORMALISED image (trailing padding run removed) that the extractor receives; the container member hash is 86e79eeaa90fbd7cebbc121a6dada007a4ee406b8f9946495950b9b8b06a265b (3145728 B, 5398 padding bytes trimmed).
